name: Burnout Drift 2: Hilltop 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Burnout Drift 2: Hilltop is a true drifting challenge and a great game for those who love car racing. Before taking to the track and racing, you can first customize your vehicle – you can adjust the suspension and body angle etc to suit your driving style.
